scaling: Integer scale with nearest-neighbour filtering: x2 1080p, x4 4K; letterbox or pixel-perfect fractional for 1440p.

projection.comment: u 0..1 along the court (net 0.5), v 0..1 far to near sideline. y = top_y + v*(bottom_y-top_y); half = top_half + v*(bottom_half-top_half); x = center_x + (u-0.5)*2*half. Sprite scale at v = half/bottom_half (optional; the mocks don't scale).

court_mask_doc: court_mask.png is 8-bit; each pixel is a role id. Recolour the ground by role (presets in data/court_colors.json); the venue's ground layer is the default colouring.

players.anchor_doc: Feet: the frame pixel on the ground at the body's centre. Facing right; flip horizontally for left, mirroring the anchor to frame_width - 1 - x.
players.cap_doc: The cap is an overlay sheet with the same frames: draw it right after the body. Leave it off for bareheaded players or swap in another hat.

roles.hats_doc: Hat overlays (role sheets only), drawn like the cap: visor and headband in the shoe accent (k, K), tricorn in hair with a white (Z) trim, bandana in the shirt ramp. SNES ADR-060 (PORT-38): beanie, whirly, backcap, bucket in the shirt ramp (whirly blades in the accent), crown silver with shirt jewels, chef white, viking grey with white horns and a shirt band.
roles.doc: Pixel value = index into 'order' (0 transparent). Build a palette from palettes.json: base + team + paddle + skin + hair; shoe accent k/K = team M/d.

crowd.doc: Row = person, column 0 idle, 1 cheer. Sitting people anchor at the seat, standing people at the feet.

net_post.doc: Y-sort with the players at the near sideline.

buttons.doc: SFC colours (A red, B yellow, X blue, Y green); B_red matches the mocks' prompt.

hud_layout.doc: Boxes are [x, y, w, h] at 960x540 for a 9-slice panel; text is centred in the box. Scores use font 'big' tinted with the team colour (label) and white (digits); titles use 'big_gold'; prompts and subtitles use 'small'.

park.draw_order_doc: Draw layers by z. Game sprites (shadows, players, ball, near net post; y-sorted) go after 'net' and before 'front'. Crowd sprites go after 'stands'. Offset each layer by -camera * parallax.
